cost_note: Muse Glimmer 30B list price, cached input counted as input, no cache discount

definition_notes.cost: coding-model usage delta x the model list price from GET /v1/models, cached input at full price, as in the frozen rows; cost_usd_all_models adds Clef and embedding deltas
definition_notes.cutoffs: the session cap and the soft spend cutoff are the frozen runner's; its repeated-tool-failure stop and its bootstrap proxy are not used (a user's OpenCode has neither)
definition_notes.kalari_tokens: tokens_input/tokens_output are OpenCode step totals (input excludes cache reads), as in the frozen Kalari rows; usage_delta holds the account-wide counts
definition_notes.reference_tokens: tokens_input/tokens_output are the coding model usage delta, as in the frozen reference rows
definition_notes.retries: API retry journals read-only: lines appended after a phase-start line count, counted by the frozen retry_journal.summarize; the frozen harness truncated the journals instead

http_retries.note: an HTTP retry inside one consumer process is not a sandbox run

retry_measure.note: an HTTP retry inside one consumer process is not a sandbox run

agent.window: lines appended after the phase-start line count (read-only; the frozen harness truncated instead)

grading.window: lines appended after the phase-start line count (read-only; the frozen harness truncated instead)

retry_measure.source: API retry journals, line offset at each phase start, read at each phase end (read-only)
